name: Pi-hole
description: DNS queries and how many were blocked, from Pi-hole 6
comment: Pi-hole 6 (FTL v6 API). POST /api/auth with {"password"} answers {"session": {"sid", "validity"}} (docs.pi-hole.net/api/auth); every other request carries the sid in X-FTL-SID. GET /api/stats/summary answers queries.{total, blocked, percent_blocked, unique_domains, forwarded, cached}, clients.{active, total} and gravity.{domains_being_blocked, last_update}, from the stats.yaml spec in pi-hole/FTL (src/api/docs/content/specs). Pi-hole 5 and older have another API and are not covered. An app password (Settings, Web interface / API) works instead of the login password (docs.pi-hole.net/api/auth).

placeholders.label: Address of Pi-hole
placeholders.hint: The address you open Pi-hole's web interface with, without /admin, such as http://pi.hole or http://192.168.1.2:8080.

source.name: Pi-hole
source.secretHint: An app password from Pi-hole (Settings, Web interface / API, Configure app password), or the password you log in with. GDash logs in with it and keeps the session it gets encrypted in memory.
